trials.visible_evidence: Bilateral grasp established around 9.7-10.0 s. Across 40 contiguous 20 Hz frames from 12.00-14.00 s, the cube remains pinched between opposed fingers, unsupported, and several cube heights above the mat.

Bilateral grasp established around 5.2-5.5 s. Across 40 contiguous 20 Hz frames from 7.00-9.00 s, the cube remains centered between opposed fingers, unsupported, and several cube heights above the mat.
